job.caption: An inspiring instrumental ambient bed blending subtle traditional Ethiopian pentatonic motifs with acoustic guitar, soft woodwinds, and warm cinematic strings. The mood is noble and triumphant yet intimate, acting as a gentle, non-intrusive background texture under narration without any strong lead melody.
